title: 52nd sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/52/2024).
Committee report on its review of the Bill amending the Constitution of the Republic of Maldives, submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhudhoo MP Mohamed Shahid.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: An evening sitting (5:30 pm) to take up the committee report on the government's Constitution amendment bill and vote on it.
